question: National Institute of Kathak dance is located in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Institute of Kathak Dance** is located in **New Delhi, India.**
 
• The institute was established in **1980 **by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi,** an autonomous organization under the **Ministry of Culture, Government of India,** to promote and preserve the classical dance form of Kathak.
 
• Kathak dance is one of the **eight classical dance forms** of India and is known for its** intricate footwork, graceful movements,** and storytelling through dance.
 
• It originated in the northern part of India and has its** roots in the Mughal era.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Varanasi **is known for its rich cultural heritage and is home to many renowned **classical dancers and musicians.**
 
• **Lucknow** is considered the cultural hub of** Uttar Pradesh** and is known for its contribution to the development of **Kathak dance.**
